I investigated this test as well as the other one `TestWebSocketClient_ProtocolVersions` that failed too https://prow.k8s.io/view/gs/kubernetes-jenkins/pr-logs/directory/pull-kubernetes-unit/1719640131654127616. 

I think, the problem happens for the test cases where test http server returns immediately without any functionality. So that http server returns and closes connection but error streaming https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/168998e87bfd49a1b0bc6402761fafd5ace3bb3b/staging/src/k8s.io/client-go/tools/remotecommand/websocket.go#L170 isn't ready yet to catch this and that makes the test failing.

If I add a some kind of a sleep after this line https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/168998e87bfd49a1b0bc6402761fafd5ace3bb3b/staging/src/k8s.io/client-go/tools/remotecommand/websocket_test.go#L712, test `go test -v -run TestWebSocketClient_ProtocolVersions -count 50` is passing.
